newsitem.title: USA: Market Guide files trademark suit.
newsitem.headline: Market Guide files trademark suit.

text.p: Market Guide Inc said on Tuesday that it filed a trademark infringement lawsuit against Information Clearinghouse Inc, which filed a suit against Market Guide.
Market Guide said it filed the suit against Information Clearinghouse, which does business as F&D Reports, for using Market Guide's newly designed slogan, "On-Line, On-Time, On-Target."
Market Guide uses the slogan for its Internet-based credit reporting service, CreditRisk Monitor, the company said.
Lawrence Sarf was also named in Market Guide's lawsuit, but it could not immediately be determined what his relationship is with Information Clearinghouse.
Market Guide's lawsuit was filed in U.S. District court for the Eastern District of New York.
Market Guide said it does not expect the countersuit filed in Nassau County (N.Y.) Supreme Court to have a material effect on its business activities.
Representatives from Nassau County Supreme Court were not immediately available.
